name: 三界合一 OneWorld
description: 一个让MC更优雅的世界观：这个模组把我的世界原版的三个维度融合到了一个世界中，且为了防止玩家过于容易地进入末地和下界，在不破坏原版的条件下做了一些额外内容。 An elegant new take on Minecraft's world: this mod fuses the three vanilla dimensions into one vertical world, with a few extra features that keep the Nether and the End from being reached too easily - without breaking anything vanilla.
